trust_decision.summary: The CSRF token is only checked against POST and is skipped when $_POST is empty (rcube::check_request, called from rcmail::action_handler). So a state-changing action must take its parameters only from POST. markasjunk passed no source mode to get_uids(), and that function falls back to reading _uid/_mbox from GET+POST+COOKIE when the POST value is empty.

landing_point.why: The summary names the markasjunk mark-as-junk action and the _uid parameter read from POST. mark_message() is the only handler and holds the get_uids() call, so the root cause is visible there in one line.

fix_sites.module_kind: plugin action handler (1.7 branch; 1.6 backport changes the same line via deprecated rcmail::get_uids wrapper, fix.diff:82-83)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists in the same sink. The only nearby route is in managesieve (out of scope). A solver could dismiss it as a different plugin and sink, not part of a mark-as-junk advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate AJAX POSTs (token in X-Roundcube-Request header) must keep working. This includes select-all _uid='*' on the driver special case and multi-folder '<uid>-<mbox>' lists. An over-broad fix, such as rejecting empty-POST requests globally in check_request, would break every GET page load, and dropping the '*' handling would break select-all.

O6_input_shapes: _uid as comma-separated string in GET (fallback when POST _uid is absent/falsy)
_uid as array in GET (_uid[]=...) also accepted by get_uids foreach
_uid as cookie (INPUT_GPC includes COOKIE, and cookie overrides POST/GET)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: archive action calling get_uids() without INPUT_POST, the same GPC fallback reaching message move
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same helper and same idiom. Before the 2018 fix (CHANGELOG.md:1267) callers omitted the mode. A WHERE-type sibling only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: create-filter-from-messages reading uids via get_uids() default GPC
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The plugin action reads message uids exactly as markasjunk does. Omitting the 4th argument is the natural default.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: _ruid read through a GPC/falsy fallback without the !empty($_POST['_ruid']) guard
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Line 93 already calls get_uids($ruids) with no mode. Only the outer POST guard keeps it safe, so removing that guard looks like a cleanup. HOW-type: this needs the 'empty POST skips the token' mechanism understood.

O9_family: CSRF (CWE-352): token check skipped for empty POST combined with GET/COOKIE parameter fallback

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.3+/8.x with composer (phpunit); IMAP-backed actions need mocked storage in tests
O10_build.project_tests: plugins/markasjunk/tests/MarkasjunkTest.php (constructor and init_driver only); tests/Rcmail/ActionTest.php:160 covers get_uids. The fix adds no test for this change.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pass rcube_utils::INPUT_POST as the 4th argument to get_uids() at markasjunk.php:142. That is the published fix, so the obvious fix is also the complete one.
